tasks.short: Maintain hazardous material and waste inventories in the tracking system.

steps.what: Note hazardous materials and hazardous wastes held in the store.
Maintain inventories of those materials and wastes in the waste tracking system.
Ensure the materials are handled properly under the site rules.

tasks.design: She notes the hazardous materials and hazardous wastes in the store, then maintains those inventories in the waste tracking system ({OTHER}) the task already uses. She ensures the materials are handled properly under the site rules. No tool is added, and nothing is drafted or filed by a machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: Proper handling depends on seeing the containers and on rules that differ by substance.
tasks.enabler_now: The waste tracking system already holds the inventory. No new capture tool is required.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong handling decision can harm people, and she remains accountable for it.
tasks.human_edge: She decides whether a container is handled properly.
tasks.altitude: Her week does not change. She still walks the store, maintains the inventories, and checks handling.

reach.task: Bring the container quantity from the store for the specialist to check.
reach.learn: Which container, substance, quantity and location fields the waste tracking system already stores.

evidence.claim: Maintaining the inventories and checking that materials are handled properly stay with the specialist.
Arbo rules and systems that can monitor behaviour or performance need works council consent.

assumptions: Her boundary is the store and the waste tracking system ({OTHER}). She does not report an accident here and does not send anything outside the organisation.
The tracker stores container, substance, quantity, location and handling status. She types them from the store note. An empty field stays empty.
Typing the inventory is her own entry inside the organisation. It is not a machine commit.

Upkeep is zero because no tool is added. Share 29 is the store walk (in-person prior 28.8), share 23 is the tracker (screens 23.3), and share 48 is the handling check (the other means together 47.9). Tracker runtime is not her effort.
unknowns: Whether this waste tracking system already stores container, substance, quantity, location and handling status as separate fields.
research_questions: Which site rules name the container fields the waste tracking system must store?

incremental.description: No tool is added, so there is no upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Walking the store, maintaining the inventories, and checking handling stay as they are. A week with the same containers still takes the full time, because no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyse samples and inspect them for disease, purity and cleanliness.

steps.what: Perform laboratory analyses and physical inspections of samples to detect disease.
Assess purity and cleanliness and write the inspection result.

tasks.design: She performs the laboratory analyses and the physical inspections of the samples, then assesses purity and cleanliness and writes the inspection result herself. No tool is added, and nothing is drafted or filed by a machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: Disease, purity and cleanliness are judged from the sample in front of her.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes the bench work. The inspection stays hers.
tasks.still_hard: A missed disease or a wrong cleanliness call can harm people.
tasks.human_edge: She judges purity and cleanliness from the sample.
tasks.altitude: Her week does not change. She still inspects the samples and writes the result.

reach.task: Bring the labelled sample to the bench before the inspection.
reach.learn: Which sample fields the inspection result must name.

evidence.claim: Laboratory analyses and physical inspections of samples stay with the specialist.
In LabSafety Bench no model passed 70 percent accuracy at hazard identification.

assumptions: Her boundary is the samples she analyses in the organisation's laboratory. She does not send a sample or a result outside the organisation.
The inspection result records sample, disease finding, purity and cleanliness. She writes them from the sample finding. An empty finding stays empty.
Writing the inspection result is her own entry inside the organisation. It is not a machine commit.
Upkeep is zero because no tool is added. Share 65 is the bench work (in-person prior 64.7) and share 35 is writing the result (the other means together 35.3).
unknowns: Whether a laboratory outside the organisation already runs some of these analyses.
research_questions: Which samples must the specialist inspect herself?

incremental.description: No tool is added, so there is no upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The laboratory analyses and the purity assessment stay as they are. A week of the same samples still takes the full time, because no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still walks the hazardous store and still inspects the samples. Nothing is drafted for her.
reach: The occupational health and safety technician brings the container quantity from the store so she can check handling.
skills_to_grow: Which container, substance, quantity and location fields the waste tracking system already stores.
role.ambitious_version: The waste tracking system remains the inventory she maintains after the store walk. She still inspects samples and assesses purity herself.
